name: Tier 3: Cross-Feature Combinations Suite
description: Pairwise and multi-variable interactions across sizing, discovery, closing, multi-agent roles, model tiers, circuit breakers, and adapters (8 comprehensive combination suites).

suites.name: Sizing (Tier 1) × Discovery (Light) × Micro-Spec × Worker (Tier 2/3) × Fast Closing
suites.description: Validates the complete lifecycle interaction for a small hotfix in a production repository.
interaction_flow: Discovery identifies repository type, package manager (pnpm), and build command
Sizing evaluates 4 questionnaire items -> all NO -> activates Tier 1 Fast-Track
Micro-spec authored under 25 lines affecting <=3 files
Worker executes change adhering to ponytail simplicity
Single-turn execution passes tests without tripping circuit breaker
Closing signs off PVS and adds concise entry to Engram.md
invariants: Micro-spec line count <= 25
Affected files count <= 3
Net changed LOC <= 80
Zero schema or breaking contract changes
Estimated token consumption < 4,500 tokens

suites.name: Sizing Escalation × Circuit Breaker × Full SDD Switch
suites.description: Validates dynamic escalation when a hotfix discovers schema dependencies requiring Tier 2 Standard SDD.

variables.trigger: database schema mutation discovered during implementation

interaction_flow: Worker starts implementation under Tier 1 micro-spec
Worker identifies that fix requires altering a shared database column
Dynamic escalation circuit breaker trips immediately
Worker halts code mutation and packages escalation dossier
Orchestrator elevates task to Tier 2 Standard SDD
Standard specification drafted in specs/_template.md with formal acceptance criteria
Worker resumes under Tier 2 contract with Reviewer gate
invariants: Zero unauthorized schema mutation under Tier 1
Circuit breaker prevents illegal out-of-scope modifications
Full SDD phases (SPEC -> DISEÑO -> IMPL -> VERIF) enforced upon escalation

suites.name: Multi-Agent Role Chain (Orchestrator → Worker → Reviewer) × 80/20 Token Budget
suites.description: Validates delegation across 3 specialized roles while maintaining the 80/20 token budget ratio.
interaction_flow: Orchestrator designs Result Contract and feature spec in specs/
Orchestrator dispatches Worker via message (<300 words) referencing spec path
Worker implements feature in src/ and runs local verification command
Worker submits handoff report to Reviewer
Reviewer verifies acceptance criteria, type safety, and <300 line PR limit
Reviewer signs off and notifies Orchestrator
invariants: Orchestrator touches 0 application source files in src/
All coordination messages <= 300 words
>=80% of total tokens processed by Tier 2 models
PR net lines <= 300 LOC

suites.name: Tier 3 Epic Sizing × Full Discovery × Milestone Slices × Adversarial Challenger × Forensic Auditor
suites.description: Validates high-assurance governance for complex architectural transformations.
interaction_flow: Discovery Specialist conducts 6-pillar audit, compiling ARCH_AUDIT.md
Sizing classifies task as Tier 3 Epic (>10 files, architectural impact)
Orchestrator drafts specs/_template_epic.md decomposing into 3 independent slices
Challenger stress-tests architecture for race conditions, boundary failures, and security gaps
Challenger approves and signs Adversarial Review Gate
Workers implement slices M1, M2, M3 sequentially under Tier 2 specs
Forensic Auditor audits full git diff against main: verifies test assertion integrity and lockfiles
Forensic Auditor issues Signed Integrity Certificate; Closing protocol completes
invariants: Zero code writing permitted prior to signed Adversarial Review Gate
All slices form a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with <300 LOC each
Forensic Auditor retains absolute binary veto over release
Rollback strategy fully documented and verified

suites.name: Multi-Environment Adapters × 7 Roles × Sandboxing Fallbacks
suites.description: Validates runtime portability of the 7 roles across Antigravity, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
interaction_flow: Master rules in AGENTS.md verified identical across all runtime environments
Antigravity executes with tool-based sandboxing; fallback to file inspection verified on permission denial
Claude Code CLI loads CLAUDE.md with prompt caching prefix discipline
OpenCode executes with local SLM constrained context (8k-32k) loading scoped specs
All 7 role invariants hold identically across all 3 platforms
invariants: Zero vendor brand names in core phase harnesses
Graceful fallback to read-only file tools upon sandbox denial
Universal tripartite coordination envelope respected across environments

suites.name: Token Budget Rules × File-Based Coordination × 100-Line BRIEFING × 150-Line Engram
suites.description: Validates system-wide memory discipline and anti-bloat invariants across long multi-turn sessions.
interaction_flow: Agent records working memory in BRIEFING.md; locked sections (🔒) remain immutable
When BRIEFING.md approaches 100 lines, past mutable entries move to BRIEFING_ARCHIVE.md
Inter-agent messages pass file paths only; zero code dumps permitted in chat payloads
At project closing, Engram.md synchronized with new decisions and status
When Engram.md exceeds 150 lines, completed features pruned to docs/engram_archive.md
invariants: BRIEFING.md strictly < 100 lines
Engram.md strictly between 80 and 150 lines
All coordination messages < 300 words
Zero quadratic conversational context bloat

suites.name: Worker Retry Failure × 2-Attempt Breaker Escalation × Orchestrator Intervention
suites.description: Validates error containment and circuit breaker escalation during persistent build/test failures.
interaction_flow: Worker executes initial code change; local test fails (Attempt 1)
Worker analyzes error log and applies code patch; re-test fails with secondary error (Attempt 2)
2-Attempt Circuit Breaker trips: Worker is legally forbidden from attempting Attempt 3
Worker compiles verbatim error log, git diff, and target file list into escalation dossier
Escalation envelope transmitted to Orchestrator
Orchestrator (Tier 1 model) diagnoses root architectural issue and provides updated guidance
Worker restarts with fresh circuit breaker state and successfully passes
invariants: Worker never executes Attempt 3 under any circumstance
Halts infinite retry loops and eliminates runaway token billing
Escalation dossier provides complete verbatim error context

suites.name: Adversarial Threat Detection × Forensic Integrity Violation × Rollback Execution
suites.description: Validates red-team adversarial detection, auditor veto authority, and rollback invocation.
interaction_flow: Worker weakens test assertion (e.g. changing strict equality to true) to force a passing build
Reviewer performs standard style review and misses the subtle assertion edit
Adversarial Challenger conducts red-team probing and hypothesizes race condition exploit
Forensic Auditor audits git diff against main: detects tampered assertion in tests/
Forensic Auditor triggers BINARY VETO: merge unconditionally blocked
Rollback protocol executed per Section 5 of specs/_template_epic.md
Repository restored to clean baseline state; tampered diff eradicated
invariants: Forensic Auditor veto cannot be bypassed or overridden
Test suite integrity is preserved with zero loosened assertions
Clean rollback executed without data corruption or orphan files
